summary: Both earlier fixes pass their checks. The new fallback lets a scheduled export omit the matrix and restore false history failures.
blocking_findings: A-P3-8 [Blocker] review-a: A full export succeeds when the companion is missing. harness/export-site-data.py:21–28 does not distinguish the legacy test fixture from a full harness. Lines 381 and 873–886 skip the revision cutoff and omit the matrix. With only domain_trust.py absent in the full workspace, the exporter returned success and produced all three payloads. It omitted domain_trust and restored four false revision-1 history failures. A present companion that raises an error already stops before any output. Rationale: harness/weekly.sh:88 and harness/cron-daily.sh:808 use this path. harness/cron-weekly.sh:56–59 stages the changed docs after a successful export. Require the companion for a full export and preserve the byte-identical legacy fixture behavior.
evidence: HEAD matched 890d5a412e5c3d2a451acbdcc157fa6ba37f552d at the start and end. The audit covered c4560f2..890d5a4 and focused on the remediation diff from e2a6259.
Reviewed the Phase 3 plan, the spec, the test strategy and green-p3-r4.log. Commits after faa4103 changed only plan.md. The known PM-approved marker deviation is not a finding.

A-P3-1=FIX verified for the original callers. The bench-incremental fixture passes all five tests. The isolated importlib caller passes both daily-pick-board-filter tests. A direct run with a complete harness writes the matrix.

The partial fixture ran the base and current exporter with identical inputs and a fixed timestamp. benchmark.json, tracks.json and bugfix.json each matched byte-for-byte. No domain_trust block appeared.
A-P3-2=FIX verified. The actual rendering code produced a written verdict for all 112 cells. All 17 affected cells used the graded-count label, not the not-graded label.
The render check matched the kind, meaning and coverage in 251 descriptions across 61 failure-mode rows. The hy3 C line read graded 1 of 2 needed and failed 1.
A-P3-3 through A-P3-7 stay nonblocking in the prior review. This audit did not reopen them.

The full-workspace fault fixture suppressed only the companion file check. Result: status=0, files=3, domain_trust=False, revision1_false_failure_entries=4. With a present companion that raises RuntimeError, the error propagated with zero writes.
With the full harness intact, read-only direct script execution produced the committed benchmark payload after timestamp normalization. No docs file was changed.
TRUST_TEST passed all 17 tests. PREVIEW_CHECK=pass models=14 cells=112. METHOD_CHECK=pass probes=15 verdicts=4 kinds=3. PATH_CHECK=pass. FR3_CHECK and FR3_GUARD both returned true.
PI_CHECK=pass. The 95 Pi records reproduce the base and Green hash 7af106ad9198808345513e893633ea8dbf07eedc8f65defb8c3ccc1d606a771d.
The phase diff changes no frozen hash input. The remediation does not change the test files, probe module, preview or test strategy.
The phase changes no Measure framework script, framework contract test or registry. The observed test exits and labeled counts match the plan.
The existing build-graph located PROBES in criteria.ts. The changed exporter and HTML are outside its TypeScript analysis. Direct source review confirmed the caller table.
The audit left the pre-existing untracked runs link unchanged. It ran no model calls.
